Cases.Problem: Inconsistencies observed for user K932EPQ8IG8 in tenant my366471.crm.ondemand.com. Assigning roles or work centers to the user takes a long time, and tables are not displayed correctly when the user logs into C4C. Other users are functioning properly. The issue is specific to the replicated user K932EPQ8IG8 and does not occur with other users. The problem is reproducible during actions like assigning roles or checking changes tab, with slow performance observed consistently.
Cases.solution provided: The development team removed all existing role assignments for the affected user and then tested the functionality by reassigning and de-assigning the work centers. After performing these steps, the performance returned to normal, and the issue could no longer be reproduced. The affected user had a very large number of change log entries (more than 2 million records), which was likely contributing to the performance degradation. The solution involved clearing the inconsistencies by removing all existing assignments and then reassigning the required work centers. This refreshed the assignments and helped eliminate any inconsistencies that may exist within those tenants.

Cases.Problem: Performance issues observed with OData queries and Web Services in the productive tenant compared to the test tenant. OData queries result in timeout errors or significantly slower processing times in the productive tenant. Web Service payloads for creating Purchase Proposals take over 7 minutes to process in the productive tenant, compared to 10-20 seconds in the test tenant. Error message encountered: 'In the context of Data Services an MASKED_SENSITIVE_DATA internal server error occurred.' Issue started on 2026/02/09. Business operations are seriously threatened as urgent tasks cannot be executed. Integration with IBP for creation of Purchase Proposals is stopped due to errors with OData and Web Services. Purchasing stopped for the whole system.
Cases.solution provided: The issue is specific to the virtual data source (Scmmsdvv02) and the virtual class CL_MSDV_MDAV_IMPL, which is taking more time to fetch data. The data volume in the productive tenant is significantly larger than in the test tenant, which contributes to the performance issues. Recommendations include reducing the data volume by selecting fewer fields or adding more filters. The engineering team suggested reducing the data volume to mitigate high memory consumption during data source execution.

Cases.Problem: Resources LR0165 and LR0166 are not found in the Cost and Revenue work center for specific users. The issue occurs when the resources have two or more cost centers assigned under the Valuation tab. Users receive an error message 'Postings to resource LR0165 found; change deletion not possible' when attempting to make changes.
Cases.solution provided: For Resource LR0165 and LR0166, perform a dummy change under the Valuation tab by deleting one of the cost centers, saving, and then adding it again. If error messages are encountered, report an incident to MASKED_ORG for backend correction to bypass the validation and perform the dummy change. Once the dummy change is successfully executed, the resources should become visible to the user in the Cost and Revenue work center.

Cases.Problem: The incident involves a plan to correct and execute 80 Goods and Activity Confirmations (GACs) over 5 weekends to avoid impact on daily operations and inventory valuation. The process includes sending documents in batches, uploading stock, performing backend corrections, and ensuring the system is clean for daily movements. There is also a need to address one remaining document that was not found on the discussed lists.
Cases.solution provided: The proposed solution is a coordinated plan executed over 5 weekends. The plan includes: sending batches of documents on Friday nights, uploading stock on Saturdays, performing backend corrections on Saturday nights/Sundays, and ensuring the system is clean by Sunday nights. Additionally, a joint meeting between the customer, Technical Support, and Development is suggested to address the remaining documents. The customer is asked to confirm their commitment to the 24-hour turnaround during weekends and to provide a scheduled start date.

Cases.Problem: An exception error appears in the Removal screen for a quantity of -432 linked with a specific customer demand. The error persists even though all related documents are completed and the quantity does not exist in the stock overview or product planning page. The customer has requested a root cause analysis for the issue.
Cases.solution provided: The customer has approved the deletion of the exception error in the Removal process. The support team has been working on creating a clone system to investigate the issue further. The clone system creation process involves coordinating with the Operations team to determine the required downtime and scheduling the cloning activity outside of the CMP window. The support team has also been checking with the development team to find alternative solutions to cancel the exception error.
